mechanism_narrative: A rising GDPC1 indicates strong economic growth, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in UNRATE above 5% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If UNRATE exceeds 5% but S&P 500 returns remain positive more than 35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is high and UNRATE is low, it indicates a strong economy with low unemployment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If the trigger conditions are met but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, high FEDFUNDS leads to decreased borrowing, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is high in a tightening cycle but S&P 500 returns are positive more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing INDPRO suggests higher production levels, positively influencing S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in RSAFS indicates reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines but S&P 500 returns remain positive more than 35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDPC1 growth combined with low FEDFUNDS indicates a positive economic outlook, leading to higher S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If trigger conditions are met but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, low UNRATE signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is low in late-cycle but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 35% of the time.
